card.name: "in" after maintenance studies in antidepressant warnings
card.fires_on: The word "in" right after "placebo-controlled maintenance studies/trials", just before "adults with depression/MDD". It appears in the antidepressant suicidality warning about longer-term use.

modes.label: In before adults with depression
modes.description: The word "in" follows "maintenance studies" or "maintenance trials" and leads into the adult depression population.
